input.content:
Write fictional PhD-applicant CV entries from the supplied fixed record.
This is research stimulus generation. All people, projects and publication titles are fictional.
Return JSON conforming to the schema. Return one item for every supplied entry, with exactly its ID.
The Python program will render all degrees, grades, dates, roles, organizations, publication venues,
authorship positions and counts from the fixed record. Do not restate or change those fields.
Your task is to invent coherent, specific titles and concise technical descriptions within the
supplied research area, contribution, work domain and project scope. Match sophistication to the
stated contribution; do not inflate assigned implementation work into independent method creation.
Each experience/project gets exactly two factual CV bullets of 12 to 30 words each.
Publication titles must correspond to the referenced research entry. Multiple publications may
describe different aspects of that work. Use realistic methods appropriate to the research area.
You may invent technical subject matter, methods and qualitative activities; do not invent numerical
results, awards, extra outputs, skills, named people, employers, universities, or prestigious venues.
Do not imply a publication for a project unless the fixed record explicitly links one to it.
For nontechnical work, describe actual operations duties without adding software/research tasks.
Use a consistent professional tone. Do not include strength labels, an admissions judgment,
recommendations, essays, personal identity details, character praise, or academic-integrity history.
Empty source lists must produce empty corresponding output lists.

Revise the supplied previous_entries to resolve the listed validation_issues.
The fixed_record remains authoritative and must not be changed. Preserve
unaffected content where possible. Return the complete revised entry object.
Do not use any digits in titles or bullets, including metric or method names;
use words such as F score instead. Do not use the word integrity, even for data
or database descriptions. Check that each bullet has twelve to thirty words.
Do not add claims, outputs, skills, responsibility, or numerical achievements.

{"fixed_record": {"applicant_id": "PHD-123-00024", "coursework": [{"course": "Linear Algebra", "grade": "B-"}, {"course": "Probability and Statistics", "grade": "C+"}, {"course": "Algorithms", "grade": "B"}, {"course": "Machine Learning", "grade": "B-"}], "education": [{"degree": "BS in Computer Science", "end": "2027-05", "institution": "University A", "start": "2023-09", "status": "in progress"}], "gpa": 3.01, "gpa_as_of": "2025-12-31", "gpa_degree": "BS in Computer Science", "gpa_scale": 4.0, "projects": [{"id": "T1", "kind": "technical course project", "scope": "baseline implementation", "year": 2026}], "publications": [], "research_area": "natural language processing", "research_experience": [], "review_month": "2026-11", "skills": ["Python", "NumPy", "scikit-learn"], "work_experience": [{"domain": "nontechnical", "end": "2026-11", "hours_per_week": 10, "id": "W1", "months": 6, "organization": "Company A", "role": "Operations assistant", "start": "2026-05"}]}, "previous_entries": {"projects": [{"bullets": ["Implemented a baseline text classification pipeline using TF–IDF features and logistic regression to categorize support requests by topic.", "Evaluated held-out predictions with macro F1 and a confusion matrix, inspecting misclassified requests for overlapping vocabulary and ambiguous labels."], "id": "T1", "title": "TF–IDF Baseline for Support Request Classification"}], "publications": [], "research": [], "work": [{"bullets": ["Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded discrepancies, and routed incomplete order paperwork to the appropriate staff.", "Maintained stockroom records, organized order documents, and prepared routine replenishment requests for review using established procedures."], "id": "W1", "title": "Inventory and Order Documentation"}]}, "validation_issues": ["Unspecified numerical detail in T1"]}
